semantic_response_cache_bypass.matching: Header names are case-insensitive. No-cache value is lowercased but not trimmed; Cache-Control is lowercased and checked for the no-cache substring. no-store alone does not trigger these guards.
semantic_response_cache_bypass.cache_enabled_request_gate: Explicit numeric temperature0 plus existing cache enablement is required; removing bypass does not force caching.
semantic_response_cache_bypass.scope: Gateway semantic-response-cache read and write only. No upstream prompt-cache purge, compression/reasoning-cache isolation or idempotency bypass is established.

counter_limits: Cached usage describes a retained response, not new provider consumption.
Savings and costs in gateway headers are estimates/calculations, separate from returned provider billing.
Capture only the named metadata; full headers and request/event bodies are excluded.

compression_off_limit.observation: Per-key compression opt-out and x-omniroute-compression:off disable proactive prompt compression without disabling independent reactive context-fit safety passes. Actual master/exclusion/configuration and interventions remain unobserved.

native_fixture_limit.fixture: checkSemanticCache returns null when the x-omniroute-no-cache header forces a bypass
native_fixture_limit.observed_assertion: Null response is asserted for temperature0 and explicit no-cache header.
native_fixture_limit.interpretation: This unrun fixture alone does not distinguish bypass from an ordinary miss; source read/write gates provide the narrower control contract.

limits: Pinned source controls only; the installed process/build, model/effort route and feature activation remain unqualified.
No settings/account/authentication store, management endpoint or model request was read or changed.
No feature saving, cold provider cache, complete cache namespace or final default is measured.
